verses.sloka: ततः प्रहस्तं निर्यान्तं दृष्ट्वा भीमपराक्रमम् ।उवाच सस्मितं रामो विभीषणमरिन्दमः ।। ६.५८.१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahastaṁ niryāntaṁ dṛṣṭvā bhīmaparākramam ।uvāca sasmitaṁ rāmo vibhīṣaṇamarindamaḥ ।। 6.58.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Rama seeing Prahastha, the tamer of enemies of terrific valour coming towards him, said to Vibheeshana, having a gentle smile.
translations.hindi: अकम्पन के मारे जाने का संवाद सुन, राक्षसराज रावण क्रद्ध हुआ और उदास हो, अपने मंत्रियों की ओर निहारने लगा

verses.sloka: क एष सुमहाकायो बलेन महता वृतः ।आचक्ष्व मे महाबाहो वीर्यवन्तं निशाचरम् ।। ६.५८.२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ka eṣa sumahākāyo balena mahatā vṛtaḥ ।ācakṣva me mahābāho vīryavantaṁ niśācaram ।। 6.58.2 ।।।।

translations.english: "Oh, Broad shouldered Vibheeshana! Who is this Rakshasa of gigantic form coming surrounded by a great army He seems to be a valiant one. Tell me."

verses.sloka: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः ।। ६.५८.३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.58.3 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing Raghava's words Vibheeshana replied." He is a Rakshasa, by name Prahastha, commander in chief of the army of Rakshasa king. He is widely known for his prowess, conversant with weapons and courageous. He is heroic and a third of the army of Ravana is under his command."
translations.hindi: उस पुरी की मोचेंबंदो देखने को लङ्कापुरी में चारों ओर घूमा । राक्षसा से रक्षित, अनेक मोर्चेबंदियों से युक्त तथा ध्वजा- पताकाओं एवं मालाओं से सुसज्जित लङ्कापुरी की तथा बानरो द्वारा डाले हुए पुरी के घेरों को देख, रादासराज रावण ने,

verses.sloka: एष सेनापतिस्तस्य प्रहस्तो नाम राक्षसः ।लङ्कायां राक्षसेन्द्रस्य त्रिभागबलसंवृतः ।वीर्यवानस्त्रविच्छूरः प्रख्यातश्च पराक्रमे ।। ६.५८.४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: eṣa senāpatistasya prahasto nāma rākṣasaḥ ।laṅkāyāṁ rākṣasendrasya tribhāgabalasaṁvṛtaḥ ।vīryavānastravicchūraḥ prakhyātaśca parākrame ।। 6.58.4 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing Raghava's words Vibheeshana replied." He is a Rakshasa, by name Prahastha, commander in chief of the army of Rakshasa king. He is widely known for his prowess, conversant with weapons and courageous. He is heroic and a third of the army of Ravana is under his command."

verses.sloka: ततः प्रहस्तं निर्यान्तं भीमं भीमपराक्रमम् ।गर्जन्तं सुमहाकायं राक्षसैरभिसंवृतम् ।। ६.५८.५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahastaṁ niryāntaṁ bhīmaṁ bhīmaparākramam ।garjantaṁ sumahākāyaṁ rākṣasairabhisaṁvṛtam ।। 6.58.5 ।।।।

translations.english: The huge army of powerful Vanaras saw Prahastha of terrific prowess, fierce, surrounded by Rakshasas coming towards them roaring.
translations.hindi: आर विपत्तिकाल में अपने दितैपी एव' युद्धविशारद पहस्त से कहा-हे युद्धविशारद ! शत्र, की सेना लङ्कापुरी को चारों कोर से घेर कर पुरवासियों को जिस प्रकार तंग कर रही है, उससे तो युद्ध करने के सिवाय, इन लोगों से छुटकारा पाने का, अन्य कोई उपाय मुके नटी देख पड़ता ; किन्तु स्वय से, ` अथवा कुम्मंकर्ण अथवा मेरे सेनापति तुम

verses.sloka: ददर्श महती सेना वानराणां बलीयसाम् ।अतिसञ्जातरोषाणां प्रहस्तमभिगर्जताम् ।। ६.५८.६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: dadarśa mahatī senā vānarāṇāṁ balīyasām ।atisañjātaroṣāṇāṁ prahastamabhigarjatām ।। 6.58.6 ।।।।

translations.english: The huge army of powerful Vanaras saw Prahastha of terrific prowess, fierce, surrounded by Rakshasas coming towards them roaring.
translations.hindi: राक्षसश्रेष्ठा का गर्जन सुन वानर इधर उधर भाग जाँयगे। क्योंकि वानर चपल, अशिक्षित और चञ्चलचित्त होते हैं

verses.sloka: खड्गशक्त्यृष्टिबाणाश्च शूलानि मुसलानि च ।गदाश्च परिघाः प्रासा विविधाश्च परश्वधाः ।। ६.५८.७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: khaḍgaśaktyṛṣṭibāṇāśca śūlāni musalāni ca ।gadāśca parighāḥ prāsā vividhāśca paraśvadhāḥ ।। 6.58.7 ।।।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas rushing towards Vanaras seeking victory, seizing swords, javelins, double edged swords, pikes, mallets, maces, iron bars, spears and bows of different kinds shone brightly.
translations.hindi: अथवा इन्द्रजीत, अथवा निकुम्भ-ये हो इस भार कों उठा : सकते हैं | अतएव तुम सेना को साथ लेकर तथा रथ में सवार हो कर, विजयप्राप्ति के लिए वहाँ शीघ्र जाओ, जहा वे सब वानर ठहरे हुए हैं । तुम्हा रे जाते हो वानरो सेना घबड़ा जायगी

verses.sloka: धनूंषि च विचित्राणि राक्षसानां जयैषिणाम् ।प्रगृहीतान्यशोभन्त वानरानभिधावताम् ।। ६.५८.८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: dhanūṁṣi ca vicitrāṇi rākṣasānāṁ jayaiṣiṇām ।pragṛhītānyaśobhanta vānarānabhidhāvatām ।। 6.58.8 ।।।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas rushing towards Vanaras seeking victory, seizing swords, javelins, double edged swords, pikes, mallets, maces, iron bars, spears and bows of different kinds shone brightly.

verses.sloka: जगृहुः पादपांश्चापि पुष्पितान् वानरर्षभाः ।शिलाश्च विपुला दीर्घा योद्धुकामाः प्लवङ्गमाः ।। ६.५८.९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: jagṛhuḥ pādapāṁścāpi puṣpitān vānararṣabhāḥ ।śilāśca vipulā dīrghā yoddhukāmāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ ।। 6.58.9 ।।।।

translations.english: The Vanaras burning with desire to fight, for their part went with huge trees in bloom, huge and long rocks.

verses.sloka: तेषामन्योन्यमासाद्य सङ्ग्रामः सुमहानभूत् ।बहूनामश्मवृष्टिं च शरवृष्टिं च वर्षताम् ।। ६.५८.१० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāmanyonyamāsādya saṅgrāmaḥ sumahānabhūt ।bahūnāmaśmavṛṣṭiṁ ca śaravṛṣṭiṁ ca varṣatām ।। 6.58.10 ।।।।

translations.english: Each of them approached one another with showers of rocks and many arrows and by that a great war happened.
translations.hindi: वे तुम्हारा गजेन तजन वेत ही न सह सकेंगे, जैसे हाथी सिंह का गजन नहों सह सकता । जब वानरी सेना भाग जायगी, तब लक्ष्मण सहित राम

verses.sloka: बहवो राक्षसा युद्धे बहून् वानरयूथपान् ।वानरा राक्षसांश्चापि निजघ्नुर्बहवो बहून् ।। ६.५८.११ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: bahavo rākṣasā yuddhe bahūn vānarayūthapān ।vānarā rākṣasāṁścāpi nijaghnurbahavo bahūn ।। 6.58.11 ।।।।

translations.english: In the course of war many Rakshasas killed many Vanara leaders and many Vanaras killed many Rakshasas also.
translations.hindi: प्रभुत्वरहित और निरालंब हो, तुम्हारे अधीन हो जाँयगे। हे प्रहस्त ! इस समय सन्देह तो हार ही में है, हमारे विजय में तो जुरा मी संशय नहीं है । अथवा हे प्रहस्त ! इस समय यह नहीं कहा जा सकता कि, कोन मारा जायगा; किन्तु हम लोगों की जीत निरसंशय हे

verses.sloka: शूलैः प्रमथिताः केचित् केचिच्च परमायुधैः ।परिघैराहताः केचित् केचिच्छिन्नाः परश्वधैः ।। ६.५८.१२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śūlaiḥ pramathitāḥ kecit kecicca paramāyudhaiḥ ।parighairāhatāḥ kecit kecicchinnāḥ paraśvadhaiḥ ।। 6.58.12 ।।।।

translations.english: Indeed, some were killed by Rakshasas with pikes, some by javelins, a few with iron bars, and a few were hacked with axes.
translations.hindi: ऐसी दशा में मेरे इस कथन के प्रतिकूल या अनूकूल, जिसमें मेरा हित तुम समझो, वही करो । जब रावण ने इस प्रकार कहा तब सेनापति प्रहस्त

verses.sloka: निरुच्छ्वासाः कृताः केचित् पतिता धरणीतले ।विभिन्नहृदयाः केचिदिषुसन्धानसन्दिताः ।। ६.५८.१३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nirucchvāsāḥ kṛtāḥ kecit patitā dharaṇītale ।vibhinnahṛdayāḥ kecidiṣusandhānasanditāḥ ।। 6.58.13 ।।।।

translations.english: Few got cut and deprived of life and fell on the ground. Some struck by arrows had their hearts broken into pieces.
translations.hindi: रावण से बैसे ही बोला, जैसे दैत्यराज से शुक्राचायं बोलते हैं। हे राजन्‌! हम लोगों ने कुशल मंत्रियों के साथ इस सम्बन्ध में परामशे किआ था

verses.sloka: केचिद्द्विधा कृताः खड्गैः स्फुरन्तः पतिता भुवि ।वानरा राक्षसैः शूलैः पार्श्वतश्चावदारिताः ।। ६.५८.१४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: keciddvidhā kṛtāḥ khaḍgaiḥ sphurantaḥ patitā bhuvi ।vānarā rākṣasaiḥ śūlaiḥ pārśvataścāvadāritāḥ ।। 6.58.14 ।।।।

translations.english: Few Vanaras cut into two by Rakshasas fell down and few Vanaras fell on the ground sides of the body cleft ceased life.
translations.hindi: आवशः=प्रसुत्वरहितः । (गो०) २ आपत्‌-मृर्यु पर दुःख हुबा। ( रा० ) ३ भयो -विजयस्दु । ( रा० ) वा० रा० यु०--३४ विवादश्चापि नो वृत्तः समवेवथ परस्परम्‌ प्रदानेन तु सीतायाः श्रेयो व्यवसितं मया । 34 60) न [पस में विवाद उठ खड़ा हुझ की मु डो हाई । (किन्तु) वैर आपको सीता के दे, डालने का परामशे दिआ था ऑर इसी में भलाई समझी थी

verses.sloka: वानरैश्चापि सङ्क्रुद्धै राक्षसौघाः समन्ततः ।पादपैर्गिरिशृङ्गैश्च सम्पिष्टा वसुधातले ।। ६.५८.१५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vānaraiścāpi saṅkruddhai rākṣasaughāḥ samantataḥ ।pādapairgiriśṛṅgaiśca sampiṣṭā vasudhātale ।। 6.58.15 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the highly enraged Vanaras completely crushed Rakshasas in groups by crushing them on the earth's surface with trees and mountain peaks.
translations.hindi: उस समय मैने यह भी कह दिशा था कि, यदि सीता न दी गई, तो युद्ध करना ही पड़ेगा। सो वही युद्ध करने समय प्राप्त हुआ है । हे राच्चसराज ' समय समय पर भूषणा वी कर तथा मुझसे प्रिय भाषण (मेरा जीवन तुम्हारे ही अधीन हे आदि बातें कह ) कर, तुमने सदा मुझे सम्मानित किआ अथवा मेरा उत्कर्ष बढ़ाया है

verses.sloka: वज्रस्पर्शतलैर्हस्तैर्मुष्टिभिश्च हता भृशम् ।वैमुः शोणितमास्येभ्यो विशीर्णदशनेक्षणाः ।। ६.५८.१६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vajrasparśatalairhastairmuṣṭibhiśca hatā bhṛśam ।vaimuḥ śoṇitamāsyebhyo viśīrṇadaśanekṣaṇāḥ ।। 6.58.16 ।।।।

translations.english: Hit by fists and hands that had the impact of thunderbolt, teeth and eyes smashed and fallen out, the Rakshasas vomited blood from their mouth excessively.
translations.hindi: आर विविध प्रकार से सममा बुरा कर धैयें बँघाया है । अत: इस विपत्तिकाल में, में तुम्हारे हित साधन का काम क्यों न करूँगा ? अब.मुमे न तो अपने प्राणों की रक्षा की चिन्ता है ओर न पुत्र खी तथा धनधान्य की कुछ ममता ही दे

verses.sloka: आर्तस्वनं च स्वनतां सिंहनादं च नर्दताम् ।बभूव तुमुलः शब्दो हरीणां रक्षसां युधि ।। ६.५८.१७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ārtasvanaṁ ca svanatāṁ siṁhanādaṁ ca nardatām ।babhūva tumulaḥ śabdo harīṇāṁ rakṣasāṁ yudhi ।। 6.58.17 ।।।।

translations.english: Tumultuous noise like the roar of lions arose in the battlefield with Vanaras and Rakshasas cries of pain.

verses.sloka: वानरा राक्षसाः क्रुद्धा वीरमार्गमनुव्रताः ।विवृत्तनयनाः क्रूराश्चक्रुः कर्माण्यभीतवत् ।। ६.५८.१८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vānarā rākṣasāḥ kruddhā vīramārgamanuvratāḥ ।vivṛttanayanāḥ krūrāścakruḥ karmāṇyabhītavat ।। 6.58.18 ।।।।

translations.english: Following the path of heroes and infuriated, their eyes reeling, the vanaras and rakshasas carried out their deeds without fear.

verses.sloka: नरान्तकः कुम्भहनुर्महानादः समुन्नतः ।एते प्रहस्तसचिवाः सर्वे जघ्नुर्वनौकसः ।। ६.५८.१९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: narāntakaḥ kumbhahanurmahānādaḥ samunnataḥ ।ete prahastasacivāḥ sarve jaghnurvanaukasaḥ ।। 6.58.19 ।।।।

translations.english: Naranthaka, Kumbhahanu, Mahanada, Samunnata, all these associates of Prahastha made short work of the monkeys.

verses.sloka: तेषामापततां शीघ्रं निघ्नतां चापि वानरान् ।द्विविदो गिरिशृङ्गेण जघानैकं नरान्तकम् ।। ६.५८.२० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāmāpatatāṁ śīghraṁ nighnatāṁ cāpi vānarān ।dvivido giriśṛṅgeṇa jaghānaikaṁ narāntakam ।। 6.58.20 ।।।।

translations.english: Rushing at great speed, the Rakshasas and also killing the Vanaras in that way, Dwivida alone struck down Naranthaka with a mountain peak.
translations.hindi: इस प्रक्रार जब प्रहस्त ने कहा, तब वे सेनाध्यच शोघ्रतापूवेक अहस्त के घर ही पर सेना एकत्र करने लगे

verses.sloka: दुर्मुखः पुनरुत्थाय कपिः स विपुलद्रुमम् ।राक्षसं क्षिप्रहस्तस्तु समुन्नतमपोथयत् ।। ६.५८.२१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: durmukhaḥ punarutthāya kapiḥ sa vipuladrumam ।rākṣasaṁ kṣiprahastastu samunnatamapothayat ।। 6.58.21 ।।।।

translations.english: Dhurmukha monkey uprooting a huge tree holding it in hand killed the Rakshasa Samunnata.
translations.hindi: सा बभूव मुहर्तेन तिग्मनानाविधाय थैः । लङ्का रोच्तसी रैस्तैगजैरिव समाकुला ।। २१:॥ थोड़ी देर में विविध प्रकार के आयुधधारी भयङ्कर वीर राक्षसों से, गर्जो की तरह लड्कापुरो भर गई

verses.sloka: जाम्बवांस्तु सुसङ्क्रुद्धः प्रगृह्य महतीं शिलाम् ।पातयामास तेजस्वी महानादस्य वक्षसि ।। ६.५८.२२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: jāmbavāṁstu susaṅkruddhaḥ pragṛhya mahatīṁ śilām ।pātayāmāsa tejasvī mahānādasya vakṣasi ।। 6.58.22 ।।।।

translations.english: Energetic Jambavantha, enraged, took a huge rock, and hurled at the chest of Mahanada who fell down.
translations.hindi: मङ्गलकामना के लिए अनेक राक्षत हवन करने लगे । बहुतों ने ब्राह्मणों की बन्दना की । होम किए हुए घो की सुगन्धि मिलने के कारण सुगन्धित हवा चलने लगी

verses.sloka: अथ कुम्भहनुस्तत्र तारेणासाद्य वीर्यवान् ।वृक्षेणाभिहतो मूर्ध्नि प्राणान् सन्त्याजयद्रणे ।। ६.५८.२३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: atha kumbhahanustatra tāreṇāsādya vīryavān ।vṛkṣeṇābhihato mūrdhni prāṇān santyājayadraṇe ।। 6.58.23 ।।।।

translations.english: And thereafter, valiant Tara closed with Kumbhahanu and attacked him with a tree on the head and he lost his life.
translations.hindi: युद्ध में जाने के लिए उद्यत अनेक राक्षस, मत्र से अभिमंत्रित विविध प्रकार के फूलों की मालाए ले आर उनको धारण कर बड़े प्रसन्न हुए

verses.sloka: अमृष्यमाणस्तत्कर्म प्रहस्तो रथमास्थितः ।चकार कदनं घोरं धनुष्पाणिर्वनौकसाम् ।। ६.५८.२४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: amṛṣyamāṇastatkarma prahasto rathamāsthitaḥ ।cakāra kadanaṁ ghoraṁ dhanuṣpāṇirvanaukasām ।। 6.58.24 ।।।।

translations.english: Then intolerant of the exploit, Prahastha got on to the chariot with bow in hand and caused dreadful havoc among the monkeys.
translations.hindi: धनुष लिये और कवच पहिने हुए राक्षसों ने सवारियों से नीचे उतर अपने राजा रावण को प्रणाम किआ और प्रहस्त के पास जा और उसे घेर कर वे खड़े हो गए

verses.sloka: आवर्त इव सञ्जज्ञे उभयोः सेनयोस्तदा ।क्षुभितस्याप्रमेयस्य सागरस्येव निस्वनः ।। ६.५८.२५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: āvarta iva sañjajñe ubhayoḥ senayostadā ।kṣubhitasyāprameyasya sāgarasyeva nisvanaḥ ।। 6.58.25 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the sound of both armies was like an agitated, boundless ocean, whirling round and frightening.
translations.hindi: फिर अति घोर भेरी बजवा आर-रावण से आज्ञा ले, प्रहरत सजे हुए एक दिव्य रथ पर चढा

verses.sloka: महता हि शरौघेण प्रहस्तो युद्धकोविदः ।अर्दयामास सङ्क्रुद्धो वानरान् परमाहवे ।। ६.५८.२६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mahatā hi śaraugheṇa prahasto yuddhakovidaḥ ।ardayāmāsa saṅkruddho vānarān paramāhave ।। 6.58.26 ।।।।

translations.english: In that major conflict, highly furious Prahastha, an expert in war tormented the Vanaras with a stream of arrows.
translations.hindi: उस रथ में बड़े शीघ्रगामी घोडे जुते हुए थे ओर बड़ा चतुर रथवान उनको हाँकता था । जब वह रथ चलता था, तब बादलों की गड़गड़ाहट जैसा शब्द होता था। वह चन्द्र सूय की तरह प्रकाशमान था

verses.sloka: वानराणां शरीरैश्च राक्षसानां च मेदिनी ।बभूव निचिता घोरा पतितैरिव पर्वतैः ।। ६.५८.२७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vānarāṇāṁ śarīraiśca rākṣasānāṁ ca medinī ।babhūva nicitā ghorā patitairiva parvataiḥ ।। 6.58.27 ।।।।

translations.english: The bodies of Vanaras and Rakshasas strewn on the ground, seemed like mountains had fallen.
translations.hindi: रावणंप्रेच्य--स्वामितया प्रधानंरावणं श्रभिबन्धेत्यथः । (गो०) . ७ उसके ऊपर सर्पाकार ध्वजा फदरा रही थी, शके ऊपर के कलस सुन्दर थे | वह सुत्रणं से;भूषित।था अथवा उसमें सोने की जाली लगी हुई थी । वह अपने को देख अपनो सुन्दरता की शोभा से मानों आप हा हँस रहा था

verses.sloka: सा मही रुधिरौघेण प्रच्छन्ना सम्प्रकाशते ।सञ्छन्ना माधवे मासि पलाशैरिव पुष्पितैः ।। ६.५८.२८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sā mahī rudhiraugheṇa pracchannā samprakāśate ।sañchannā mādhave māsi palāśairiva puṣpitaiḥ ।। 6.58.28 ।।।।

translations.english: That battlefield drenched with blood shone bright as though veiled with blossoms of Palasa in the month of Magha.
translations.hindi: ऐसे दिव्य रथ पर सवार हो और रावण को आज्ञा ले प्रहस्त बड़ी भारी राक्षसो सेता सहित तुरन्त लङ्का से निकला

verses.sloka: हतवीरौघवप्रां तु भग्नायुधमहाद्रुमाम् ।शोणितौघमहातोयां यमसागरगमिनीम् ।। ६.५८.२९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hatavīraughavaprāṁ tu bhagnāyudhamahādrumām ।śoṇitaughamahātoyāṁ yamasāgaragaminīm ।। 6.58.29 ।।।।

translations.english: Heaps of slain leaders as banks, broken weapons like large trees, torrents of blood as vast stretch of water, liver and spleens as its mire, scattered entrails as duckweeds, severed trunks and heads as fish, fingers and parts of limbs as grass, crowded with swans in the form of vultures, frequented with cranes in the shape of buzzards, overspread with f at in the form of foam, groans of the wounded for its murmur, difficult to cross for cowards, frequented by swans and cranes, that battlefield of river flowed. The Rakshasas and Vanaras swam across the river even though it were difficult to cross as leaders of elephant herds would cross a lotus pond covered with pollen of lotuses.

verses.sloka: यकृत्प्लीहमहापङ्कां विनिकीर्णान्त्रशैवलाम् ।भिन्नकायशिरोमीनामङ्गावयवशाद्वलाम् ।। ६.५८.३० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yakṛtplīhamahāpaṅkāṁ vinikīrṇāntraśaivalām ।bhinnakāyaśiromīnāmaṅgāvayavaśādvalām ।। 6.58.30 ।।।।

translations.english: Heaps of slain leaders as banks, broken weapons like large trees, torrents of blood as vast stretch of water, liver and spleens as its mire, scattered entrails as duckweeds, severed trunks and heads as fish, fingers and parts of limbs as grass, crowded with swans in the form of vultures, frequented with cranes in the shape of buzzards, overspread with f at in the form of foam, groans of the wounded for its murmur, difficult to cross for cowards, frequented by swans and cranes, that battlefield of river flowed. The Rakshasas and Vanaras swam across the river even though it were difficult to cross as leaders of elephant herds would cross a lotus pond covered with pollen of lotuses.
translations.hindi: जिस समय प्रहस्त चला, उस समय शङ्क को ध्वनि सुत पड़ी । उसके आगे आगे गर्जते हुए राक्षस चल्ने

verses.sloka: गृध्रहंसगणाकीर्णां कङ्कसारससेविताम् ।मेदःफेनसमाकीर्णामार्तस्तनितनिस्वनाम् ।तां कापुरुषदुस्तारां युद्धभूमिमयीं नदीम् ।। ६.५८.३१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: gṛdhrahaṁsagaṇākīrṇāṁ kaṅkasārasasevitām ।medaḥphenasamākīrṇāmārtastanitanisvanām ।tāṁ kāpuruṣadustārāṁ yuddhabhūmimayīṁ nadīm ।। 6.58.31 ।।।।

translations.english: Heaps of slain leaders as banks, broken weapons like large trees, torrents of blood as vast stretch of water, liver and spleens as its mire, scattered entrails as duckweeds, severed trunks and heads as fish, fingers and parts of limbs as grass, crowded with swans in the form of vultures, frequented with cranes in the shape of buzzards, overspread with f at in the form of foam, groans of the wounded for its murmur, difficult to cross for cowards, frequented by swans and cranes, that battlefield of river flowed. The Rakshasas and Vanaras swam across the river even though it were difficult to cross as leaders of elephant herds would cross a lotus pond covered with pollen of lotuses.

verses.sloka: नदीमिव घनापाये हंससारससेविताम् ।राक्षसाः कपिमुख्याश्च तेरुस्तां दुस्तरां नदीम् ।। ६.५८.३२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nadīmiva ghanāpāye haṁsasārasasevitām ।rākṣasāḥ kapimukhyāśca terustāṁ dustarāṁ nadīm ।। 6.58.32 ।।।।

translations.english: Heaps of slain leaders as banks, broken weapons like large trees, torrents of blood as vast stretch of water, liver and spleens as its mire, scattered entrails as duckweeds, severed trunks and heads as fish, fingers and parts of limbs as grass, crowded with swans in the form of vultures, frequented with cranes in the shape of buzzards, overspread with f at in the form of foam, groans of the wounded for its murmur, difficult to cross for cowards, frequented by swans and cranes, that battlefield of river flowed. The Rakshasas and Vanaras swam across the river even though it were difficult to cross as leaders of elephant herds would cross a lotus pond covered with pollen of lotuses.
translations.hindi: भयङ्कर रूपधारी बड़े बढ़े डीलडोल के राक्षस प्रहत के आगे आगे चलते थे । नरान्तक, कुम्भइनु, महानाद, समुन्नत | ३१ झार चलते 7 "Tr UR पन य नज % पाठान्तरे“ सागरम्‌ । › ~ ¢ Q प्रहस्तसचिवा ह्य ते निर्ययुः परिषाय तम्‌ । व्यूढेनेव सुधोरेण पूवद्वारात्स निययौ ३२ ॥ ये प्रहस्त के सचिव थे और ये सब उसको चारों ओर से घेर कर जा रहे थे । घार व्यूह की रचना कर, प्रहस्त लङ्का के पूवेद्वार से बाहिर निकला

verses.sloka: यथा पद्मरजोध्वस्तां नलिनीं गजयूथपाः ।। ६.५८.३३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yathā padmarajodhvastāṁ nalinīṁ gajayūthapāḥ ।। 6.58.33 ।।।।

translations.english: Heaps of slain leaders as banks, broken weapons like large trees, torrents of blood as vast stretch of water, liver and spleens as its mire, scattered entrails as duckweeds, severed trunks and heads as fish, fingers and parts of limbs as grass, crowded with swans in the form of vultures, frequented with cranes in the shape of buzzards, overspread with f at in the form of foam, groans of the wounded for its murmur, difficult to cross for cowards, frequented by swans and cranes, that battlefield of river flowed. The Rakshasas and Vanaras swam across the river even though it were difficult to cross as leaders of elephant herds would cross a lotus pond covered with pollen of lotuses.
translations.hindi: उस समय उसके साथ हाथियों के कुंड की तरह एक बड़ी भारी सेना थी | वह सागर को तरह अपार सेता से घिरा हुआ जा र्दा था

verses.sloka: ततः सृजन्तं बाणौघान् प्रहस्तं स्यन्दने स्थितम् ।ददर्श तरसा नीलो विनिघ्नन्तं प्लवङ्गमान् ।। ६.५८.३४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sṛjantaṁ bāṇaughān prahastaṁ syandane sthitam ।dadarśa tarasā nīlo vinighnantaṁ plavaṅgamān ।। 6.58.34 ।।।।

translations.english: Further Nila saw Prahastha seated and trembling and discharging a volley of arrows with vehemence exterminating monkeys.
translations.hindi: समस्त लङ्कावासी जीव विकट स्वर से चिल्लाने लगे। मेघशून्य आकाश में उडते हुए रुधिर धोर माँसभोजी

verses.sloka: उद्धूत इव वायुः खे महदभ्रबलं बलात् ।समीक्ष्याभिद्रुतं युद्धे प्रहस्तो वाहिनीपतिः ।रथेनादित्यवर्णेन नीलमेवाभिदुद्रुवे ।। ६.५८.३५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: uddhūta iva vāyuḥ khe mahadabhrabalaṁ balāt ।samīkṣyābhidrutaṁ yuddhe prahasto vāhinīpatiḥ ।rathenādityavarṇena nīlamevābhidudruve ।। 6.58.35 ।।।।

translations.english: Prahastha, the commander of the army darted, just as the violent wind blows away mass of clouds, observing Nila coming towards him, in his chariot which was bright as the sun.

verses.sloka: स धनुर्धन्विनां श्रेष्ठो विकृष्य परमाहवे ।नीलाय व्यसृजद्बाणान् प्रहस्तो वाहिनीपतिः ।। ६.५८.३६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa dhanurdhanvināṁ śreṣṭho vikṛṣya paramāhave ।nīlāya vyasṛjadbāṇān prahasto vāhinīpatiḥ ।। 6.58.36 ।।।।

translations.english: Prahastha, the commander of the army darted, just as the violent wind blows away mass of clouds, observing Nila coming towards him, in his chariot which was bright as the sun.

verses.sloka: ते प्राप्य विशिखा नीलं विनिर्भिद्य समाहिताः ।महीं जग्मुर्महावेगा रुषिता इव पन्नगाः ।। ६.५८.३७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: te prāpya viśikhā nīlaṁ vinirbhidya samāhitāḥ ।mahīṁ jagmurmahāvegā ruṣitā iva pannagāḥ ।। 6.58.37 ।।।।

translations.english: Prahastha, the CommanderinChief of the army, supreme among wielders of bow, stretched his best bow and drew it and began to discharge arrows at Neela.
translations.hindi: आकाश से उल्कापात होने लगा--रूखी इवा भी चलने लगी । क्रुद्ध हो आपस में ग्रहों का युद्ध होने लगा । अतः समस्त ग्रह प्रभाहीन हो गए

verses.sloka: नीलः शरैरभिहतो निशितैर्ज्वलनोपमैः ।स तं परमदुर्धर्षमापतन्तं महाकपिः ।। ६.५८.३८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nīlaḥ śarairabhihato niśitairjvalanopamaiḥ ।sa taṁ paramadurdharṣamāpatantaṁ mahākapiḥ ।। 6.58.38 ।।।।

translations.english: The arrows discharged by Prahastha, penetrated piercing into Nila's body at great speed like infuriated serpents and went straight into the earth.

verses.sloka: प्रहस्तं ताडयामास वृक्षमुत्पाट्य वीर्यवान् ।। ६.५८.३९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: prahastaṁ tāḍayāmāsa vṛkṣamutpāṭya vīryavān ।। 6.58.39 ।।।।

translations.english: Great Vanara, a valiant one, Nila having been hit with arrows sharp as tongues of fire, struck Prahastha, who is most difficult to encounter and rushing towards him by uprooting a tree.

verses.sloka: स तेनाभिहतः क्रुद्धो नदन् राक्षसपुङ्गवः ।ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि प्लवङ्गानां चमूपतौ ।। ६.५८.४० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tenābhihataḥ kruddho nadan rākṣasapuṅgavaḥ ।vavarṣa śaravarṣāṇi plavaṅgānāṁ camūpatau ।। 6.58.40 ।।।।

translations.english: Great Vanara, a valiant one, Nila having been hit with arrows sharp as tongues of fire, struck Prahastha, who is most difficult to encounter and rushing towards him by uprooting a tree.
translations.hindi: रणभूमि में अनेक बार गए हुए, अनेक युद्धो में सम्मिलित हो चुकने वाले, सूतङुल में उत्पन्न रथ हाँकनेबाले रथवान के हाथ से चाबुक गिर पड़ा

verses.sloka: तस्य बाणगणान् घोरान् राक्षसस्य महाबलः ।अपारयन् वारयितुं प्रत्यगृह्णान्निमीलितः ।। ६.५८.४१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya bāṇagaṇān ghorān rākṣasasya mahābalaḥ ।apārayan vārayituṁ pratyagṛhṇānnimīlitaḥ ।। 6.58.41 ।।।।

translations.english: Having been struck by Nila, the Rakshasa leader became furious, and began to roar and showered rain arrows on the monkeys.
translations.hindi: युद्धयात्रा करते समय प्रकाशमान और अष्टवसुओं के लिए भी दुलेभ जो श्री प्रहस्त की थी, वह थोड़ी ही देर में नष्ट हो गई और समतल भूमि में दौड़ते हए घोड़े गिर पड़े

verses.sloka: यथैव गोवृषो वर्षं शारदं शीघ्रमागतम् ।एवमेव प्रहस्तस्य शरवर्षं दुरासदम् ।निमीलिताक्षः सहसा नीलः सेहे सुदारुणम् ।। ६.५८.४२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yathaiva govṛṣo varṣaṁ śāradaṁ śīghramāgatam ।evameva prahastasya śaravarṣaṁ durāsadam ।nimīlitākṣaḥ sahasā nīlaḥ sehe sudāruṇam ।। 6.58.42 ।।।।

translations.english: Not able to check the volley of arrows released by the Rakshasa, Nila received them with closed eyes.
translations.hindi: प्रसिद्ध बल पौरुष बाले प्रहस्त वो निकलते देख, रणभूमि में वानरगण वृक्ष शिला आदि विविध प्रकार के आयुध ले, उससे लड़ने को तैयार हो गए

verses.sloka: रोषितः शरवर्षेण सालेन महता महान् ।प्रजघान हयान्नीलः प्रहस्तस्य मनोजवान् ।। ६.५८.४३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: roṣitaḥ śaravarṣeṇa sālena mahatā mahān ।prajaghāna hayānnīlaḥ prahastasya manojavān ।। 6.58.43 ।।।।

translations.english: Just as a mighty bull faces sudden downpour of autumnal rain, in the same way Nila precisely tolerated the rain of arrows of Prahastha, which are difficult to face, with eyes closed.

verses.sloka: ततः स चापमुद्गृह्य प्रहस्तस्य महाबलः ।बभञ्ज तरसा नीलो ननाद च पुनःपुनः ।। ६.५८.४४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa cāpamudgṛhya prahastasya mahābalaḥ ।babhañja tarasā nīlo nanāda ca punaḥpunaḥ ।। 6.58.44 ।।।।

translations.english: Neela endowed with great prowess, became angry (by the rain of arrows showered on him) and hurled a huge Sala tree at Prahastha.
translations.hindi: एक ओर राक्षस नाद्‌ कर रहे थे दूसरी ओर बानर गर्ज रहे थे ।राक्षसी और वानरी दोनों सेनाओं में हषे छाया हुआ था

verses.sloka: विधनुस्तु कृतस्तेन प्रहस्तो वाहिनीपतिः ।प्रगृह्य मुसलं घोरं स्यन्दनादवपुप्लुवे ।। ६.५८.४५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vidhanustu kṛtastena prahasto vāhinīpatiḥ ।pragṛhya musalaṁ ghoraṁ syandanādavapupluve ।। 6.58.45 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereupon, Neela firmly holding the bow of mighty Prahastha broke it again and again and roared
translations.hindi: वसुदुलं भा-श्रष्टबसुदुलंभा | (गो ०) २ _आरुजठां-उन्मूलयतां । (गो०) अ ्् ये बलवान राक्षस और वेगवान वानर दोनो' ही एक दूसरे का नाश करने के लिए फुर्तीले और युद्ध करने में समर्थ तथा एक दूसरे का नाश करने की अभिलाषा रखने वाले योद्धा युद्ध करने के लिए एक दूसरे को ललकार रहे थे। अतः बड़ा भारी होहल्ला सुन पड़ता था

verses.sloka: तावुभौ वाहिनीमुख्यौ जातवैरौ तरस्विनौ ।स्थितौ क्षतजदिग्धाङ्गौ प्रभिन्नाविव कुञ्जरौ ।। ६.५८.४६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāvubhau vāhinīmukhyau jātavairau tarasvinau ।sthitau kṣatajadigdhāṅgau prabhinnāviva kuñjarau ।। 6.58.46 ।।।।

translations.english: Deprived of bow and chariot, Prahastha, the CommanderinChief seizing a terrific mallet jumped down from the chariot.
translations.hindi: इति सप्तपञ्चाशः सगे: ॥ तदनन्तर राक्षसो सेना का सेनापति खोटी बुद्धि वाला ्रहस्त, युद्ध में विजय प्राप्त झरने की इच्छा से, प्रत्यन्त वेग से वानरो की सेना पर वैसे ही झपटा, जैसे अपने प्राण गँवाने के लिए पतंग दइकते हुए अग्नि पर झपटता है

verses.sloka: उल्लिखन्तौ सुतीक्ष्णाभिर्दंष्ट्राभिरितरेतरम् ।सिंहशार्दूलसदृशौ सिंहशार्दूलचेष्टितौ ।। ६.५८.४७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ullikhantau sutīkṣṇābhirdaṁṣṭrābhiritaretaram ।siṁhaśārdūlasadṛśau siṁhaśārdūlaceṣṭitau ।। 6.58.47 ।।।।

translations.english: Both Nila and Prahastha, deadly enemies, CommanderinChief of the armies, their limbs disfigured, wetted with blood, stood like elephants.

verses.sloka: विक्रान्तविजयौ वीरौ समरेष्वनिवर्तिनौ ।काङ्क्षमाणौ यशः प्राप्तुं वृत्रवासवयोः समौ ।। ६.५८.४८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vikrāntavijayau vīrau samareṣvanivartinau ।kāṅkṣamāṇau yaśaḥ prāptuṁ vṛtravāsavayoḥ samau ।। 6.58.48 ।।।।

translations.english: Tearing up each other with exceedingly sharp teeth they were behaving like a lion and tiger. They had won many wars and never turned back in war. They were heroes like Vrta and Indra desiring to conquer and attain fame.

verses.sloka: आजघान तदा नीलं ललाटे मुसलेन सः ।प्रहस्तः परमायत्तस्तस्य सुस्राव शोणितम् ।। ६.५८.४९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ājaghāna tadā nīlaṁ lalāṭe musalena saḥ ।prahastaḥ paramāyattastasya susrāva śoṇitam ।। 6.58.49 ।।।।

translations.english: Tearing up each other with exceedingly sharp teeth they were behaving like a lion and tiger. They had won many wars and never turned back in war. They were heroes like Vrta and Indra desiring to conquer and attain fame.

verses.sloka: ततः शोणितदिग्धाङ्गः प्रगृह्य सुमहातरुम् ।प्रहस्तस्योरसि क्रुद्धो विससर्ज महाकपिः ।। ६.५८.५० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śoṇitadigdhāṅgaḥ pragṛhya sumahātarum ।prahastasyorasi kruddho visasarja mahākapiḥ ।। 6.58.50 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Prahastha struck speedily with a mallet and hit Neela on the forehead and blood flowed from there.

verses.sloka: तमचिन्त्य प्रहारं स प्रगृह्य मुसलं महत् ।अभिदुद्राव बलिनं बलान्नीलं प्लवङ्गमम् ।। ६.५८.५१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tamacintya prahāraṁ sa pragṛhya musalaṁ mahat ।abhidudrāva balinaṁ balānnīlaṁ plavaṅgamam ।। 6.58.51 ।।।।

translations.english: Then drenched with blood, Neela was enraged and took hold of a huge tree and hurled at the chest of Prahastha.

verses.sloka: तमुग्रवेगं संरब्धमापतन्तं महाकपिः ।ततः सम्प्रेक्ष्य जग्राह महावेगो महाशिलाम् ।। ६.५८.५२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tamugravegaṁ saṁrabdhamāpatantaṁ mahākapiḥ ।tataḥ samprekṣya jagrāha mahāvego mahāśilām ।। 6.58.52 ।।।।

translations.english: He (Prahastha), not caring for the wound, taking a huge mallet went towards that courageous monkey (Neela).

verses.sloka: तस्य युद्धाभिकामस्य मृधे मुसलयोधिनः ।प्रहस्तस्य शिलां नीलो मूर्ध्नि तूर्णमपातयत् ।। ६.५८.५३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya yuddhābhikāmasya mṛdhe musalayodhinaḥ ।prahastasya śilāṁ nīlo mūrdhni tūrṇamapātayat ।। 6.58.53 ।।।।

translations.english: Then, seeing Prahastha waging and coming towards him, the great monkey, Neela, endowed with high speed threw a huge rock.

verses.sloka: सा तेन कपिमुख्येन विमुक्ता महती शिला ।बिभेद बहुधा घोरा प्रहस्तस्य शिरस्तदा ।। ६.५८.५४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sā tena kapimukhyena vimuktā mahatī śilā ।bibheda bahudhā ghorā prahastasya śirastadā ।। 6.58.54 ।।।।

translations.english: Fighting with the mallet, Neela quickly dropped the rock on that Prahastha's forehead

verses.sloka: स गतासुर्गतश्रीको गतसत्त्वो गतेन्द्रियः ।पपात सहसा भूमौ छिन्नमूल इव द्रुमः ।। ६.५८.५५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa gatāsurgataśrīko gatasattvo gatendriyaḥ ।papāta sahasā bhūmau chinnamūla iva drumaḥ ।। 6.58.55 ।।।।

translations.english: Hurled by Neela, the foremost of monkeys, the huge rock broke the head of Prahastha into pieces.

verses.sloka: प्रभिन्नशिरसस्तस्य बहु सुस्राव शोणितम् ।शरीरादपि सुस्राव गिरेः प्रस्रवणं यथा ।। ६.५८.५६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: prabhinnaśirasastasya bahu susrāva śoṇitam ।śarīrādapi susrāva gireḥ prasravaṇaṁ yathā ।। 6.58.56 ।।।।

translations.english: Life, splendour, strength, and senses departed Prahastha fell instantly on the ground like a tree cut at the bottom.

verses.sloka: हते प्रहस्ते नीलेन तदकम्प्यं महद्बलम् ।रक्षसामप्रहृष्टानां लङ्कामभिजगाम ह ।। ६.५८.५७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hate prahaste nīlena tadakampyaṁ mahadbalam ।rakṣasāmaprahṛṣṭānāṁ laṅkāmabhijagāma ha ।। 6.58.57 ।।।।

translations.english: From his shattered head much blood flowed from all over the body just as a spring from a mountain.

verses.sloka: न शेकुः समरे स्थातुं निहते वाहिनीपतौ ।सेतुबन्धं समासाद्य विकीर्णं सलिलं यथा ।। ६.५८.५८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: na śekuḥ samare sthātuṁ nihate vāhinīpatau ।setubandhaṁ samāsādya vikīrṇaṁ salilaṁ yathā ।। 6.58.58 ।।।।

translations.english: Prahastha having been killed by Neela, the cheerless Rakshasas and unshakeable troops could not stay there any more.

verses.sloka: हते तस्मिंश्चमूमुख्ये राक्षसास्ते निरुद्यमाः ।रक्षःपतिगृहं गत्वा ध्यानमूकत्वमास्थिताः ।प्राप्ताः शोकार्णवं तीव्रं निस्सञ्ज्ञा इव ते ऽभवन् ।। ६.५८.५९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hate tasmiṁścamūmukhye rākṣasāste nirudyamāḥ ।rakṣaḥpatigṛhaṁ gatvā dhyānamūkatvamāsthitāḥ ।prāptāḥ śokārṇavaṁ tīvraṁ nissañjñā iva te 'bhavan ।। 6.58.59 ।।।।

translations.english: The CommanderinChief having been killed the troops could not remain there just as water reached a breached dam.

verses.sloka: ततस्तु नीलो विजयी महाबलः प्रशस्यमानः स्वकृतेन कर्मणा ।समेत्य रामेण सलक्ष्मणेन च प्रहृष्टरूपस्तु बभूव यूथपः ।। ६.५८.६० ।।
verses.transliteration: tatastu nīlo vijayī mahābalaḥ praśasyamānaḥ svakṛtena karmaṇā ।sametya rāmeṇa salakṣmaṇena ca prahṛṣṭarūpastu babhūva yūthapaḥ ।। 6.58.60 ।।

translations.english: CommanderinChief killed, those Rakshasas reduced to speechlessness went to the abode of their Lord and remained without consciousness.
